renderings.bsb: You made him a little lower

elsewhere.note: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little…
You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
